The '''battle of [[Juma 9]]''' took place around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] Juma 9. The [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Kul Teska]] led [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battles droids]] on an attack on the station.

==The battle==
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] initiated the assault with a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] and [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]]. The boarding ships delivered [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]], and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. Kul Teska and [[Chameleon droid/Legends|chameleon droids]] also reached the station. Teska went to the communications center and the chameleon droids made their way to the station's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]].

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] were both in the station at the time and were quick to react. The two [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] moved through the facility, helping [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troops]] they came across. The Jedi eventually reached the station's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. There, Plo Koon ordered all the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to their ships. As the two cleared the hangar of droids, Kenobi contacted [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] on his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Kenobi ordered the commander, nicknamed Cody, to divert power to the space station's shields. Cody took the order and informed General Kenobi of the droids near the reactor.

Cody lead a small group of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to the generator room to reroute power to the shields. The group fought their way through many [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to the generator and [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into several consoles to bring more power to the shields. Meanwhile, Kenobi and Koon went to the reactor. There they found and destroyed the chameleon droids to prevent them from further harming the reactor. After securing the reactor core, the Jedi traveled to the communications center. Kul Teska noticed them enter and ended his conversation with Separatist leader Count Dooku. The Jedi attempted to place Teska under arrest, but Teska was able to distract the two by detonating explosives placed throughout the space station.

As the detonations rocked the station, Kenobi ordered Cody to get to the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Cody complied and made sure several other clone troopers made it to escape pods first. However, the last pod Cody tried to launch was unable to leave on its own. A clone called [[Switch (clone trooper)|Switch]] stayed behind on the station to launch the pod manually.

Plo Koon and Obi-Wan Kenobi eventually cornered Teska in a windowed room. In the ensuing skirmish, Teska used chameleon droids to get an edge on the Jedi, but it to no avail. The Jedi managed to get the Skakoan through an open window and seal it back up at the cost of both their lightsabers. Kenobi and Koon remained trapped in the chamber. Teska, however, survived the vacuum of space and traveled to Ryloth.

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] later arrived with reinforcements on a rescue mission. After fighting their way through the station and rescuing Switch, they arrived at the control room, while [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|commanders]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]] and [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] searched the outer walls of the space station for remaining droids and found Plo Koon's and Obi-Wan Kenobi's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] floating in space.
